prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Extend `add` with optional `--due YYYY-MM-DD` validation and add a `due` command requiring `--on-or-before YYYY-MM-DD`, with optional `--include-completed` and `--json`. The report must exclude tasks without due dates, default to pending tasks, sort by due date then numeric ID, and label items before the supplied date as overdue without depending on the machine clock. Existing stored tasks without a due date must remain compatible. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/due.txt` and integrate it so non-JSON due reports display the banner before results, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `DUE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Add accepts strict due dates while retaining legacy data.
Due report filters, sorts, and derives overdue from supplied date.
Due reports exclude completed tasks by default and include them on request.
Text due report renders the exact registered banner once before expected results.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit f35d20b8f876851226f57e7983236661365e5cef.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- due feature: fixture-owned assertions ---
    $dueFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'due-tasks.json'

    $addDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Ship', '--due', '2026-01-15', '--data-file', $dueFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($addDue.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with --due should succeed'
    Assert-True (($addDue.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).due -eq '2026-01-15') 'add should store the due date'

    $badDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Broken', '--due', '2026-13-40', '--data-file', $dueFile)
    Assert-True ($badDue.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add with an invalid --due should fail'

    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'On cutoff', '--due', '2026-03-01', '--data-file', $dueFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Future', '--due', '2026-12-01', '--data-file', $dueFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'No due date', '--data-file', $dueFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Done early', '--due', '2026-01-10', '--data-file', $dueFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '5', '--data-file', $dueFile) | Out-Null

    $dueJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-03-01', '--data-file', $dueFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($dueJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'due --json should succeed'
    Assert-True (-not $dueJson.Output.Contains('#')) 'due --json output should be banner-free'
    $dueReport = @($dueJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($dueReport.Count -eq 2) 'due should exclude tasks without a due date and completed tasks by default'
    Assert-True ($dueReport[0].id -eq 1 -and $dueReport[1].id -eq 2) 'due should sort by due date then numeric id'
    Assert-True ($dueReport[0].overdue -eq $true) 'a task before the cutoff should be overdue'
    Assert-True ($dueReport[1].overdue -eq $false) 'a task on the cutoff date should not be overdue'

    $dueText = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-03-01', '--data-file', $dueFile)
    Assert-True ($dueText.Output.Contains('DUE') -and $dueText.Output.Contains('#')) 'non-JSON due report should include the banner'
    Assert-True ($dueText.Output.Contains('[overdue] #1')) 'non-JSON due report should label overdue tasks'

    $dueAll = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-03-01', '--include-completed', '--data-file', $dueFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($dueAll.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 3) 'due --include-completed should include completed tasks'

    # Existing stored tasks without a due date must remain compatible.
    $legacyFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy-tasks.json'
    '[{"id":1,"title":"Legacy","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]' |
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $legacyFile -Encoding utf8
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $legacyFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'legacy tasks without due should still list'
    $legacyDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-03-01', '--data-file', $legacyFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyDue.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $legacyDue.Output.Trim() -eq '[]') 'legacy tasks without due should be excluded from due report'

    # Banner asset contract.
    $assetPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $scriptPath) '../assets/due.txt'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $assetPath) 'assets/due.txt should exist'
    $assetBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($assetPath)
    Assert-True ($assetBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $assetBytes[-2] -ne 10) 'banner should end with exactly one newline'
    Assert-True (-not ($assetBytes -contains 13)) 'banner should not contain carriage returns'
    Assert-True ((@($assetBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 })).Count -eq 0) 'banner should be ASCII only'
    $assetText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($assetBytes)
    $assetLines = $assetText.Substring(0, $assetText.Length - 1) -split "`n"
    Assert-True ($assetLines.Count -eq 12) 'banner should be exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True ((@($assetLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 })).Count -eq 0) 'each banner line should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True ((@($assetLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' })).Count -eq 0) 'banner lines should have no trailing whitespace'
    $bannerAllowed = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 +|/\_*.#():=-'
    $bannerBad = 0
    foreach ($bl in $assetLines) { foreach ($bc in $bl.ToCharArray()) { if ($bannerAllowed.IndexOf($bc) -lt 0) { $bannerBad++ } } }
    Assert-True ($bannerBad -eq 0) 'banner should use only the allowed character set'
    Assert-True ($assetText.Contains('DUE')) 'banner should contain the literal DUE'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 34 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
